user_stories.title: Add py.typed marker to auto_prd package
acceptance_criteria: File is readable and contains no content (empty file)
Mypy recognizes the package as typed when running type checks
user_stories.notes: Per PEP 561, typed packages must include a py.typed marker file in the package directory. This enables mypy to properly analyze internal imports and catch type errors within the package itself.

user_stories.title: Remove --ignore-missing-imports flag from typecheck target
acceptance_criteria: Makefile typecheck target (lines 79-81) no longer includes --ignore-missing-imports flag
Running 'make typecheck' reports 62 type errors (increased from 22)
The command still uses $(PYTHON) variable for Python interpreter
The command still cd's to $(TOOLS_DIR) before running mypy
user_stories.notes: The --ignore-missing-imports flag hides 40+ legitimate type errors. Removing this flag exposes all type errors, allowing developers to see and fix them. The $(PYTHON) variable is already in use (line 2 defines it as python3), satisfying that constraint.

user_stories.title: Preserve typecheck-lenient target for CI compatibility
acceptance_criteria: Target still uses '|| true' to ignore exit code
CI workflow continues to pass after changes
user_stories.notes: The typecheck-lenient target is used by CI via 'make ci' (line 35). Keeping it unchanged ensures CI continues to pass during the transition period while developers work on fixing the newly exposed type errors.

user_stories.title: Verify all tooling targets still work correctly
acceptance_criteria: make lint passes (both Go and Python linting)
